responsibility: Declares the TyTyResolveCompile visitor that maps Rust TyTy semantic types onto GCC trees. It exposes the main static compile entry point and the visitor coverage for all supported Rust type categories, along with helper hooks for slice and str layout construction and the implicit enumeral type used by enum lowering.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TyTyResolveCompile visitor, its static compile helpers, and helper hooks for special type construction. Unlike rust-compile-type.cc, it specifies the type-lowering interface and visitor coverage without building the GCC type trees themselves.
